rules.name: cs-30-template-list-uat
rules.sql: SELECT t.business_unit, t.business_application, t.doc_template_name, t.uuid::text AS uuid, t.status, t.template_engine, t.template_file_name, t.mime_type, length(t.document_content) AS bytes, encode(sha256(t.document_content), 'hex') AS sha256, t.updated_by, t.updated_timestamp FROM opera.oga_doctemplatemaster_doctemplatemaster t WHERE t.tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(t.doc_template_name) LIKE 'clientstatement%' ORDER BY t.doc_template_name, t.business_unit, t.business_application
